title: The goal research checks a DER inference against the probe it cites and the sprint's own bug evidence before it lands
goal: A goal research story that writes a DER fact citing a probe in the same article states the probe's outcome as the probe bullet does, and reads the sprint's bug items on the same host before it infers a tool's behaviour there; the research worker's brief says so. Retrospective of SP-u5q37ds3: ST-ra7u7hwd's summary said both soft-404 texts can be empty citing a probe whose made-up sibling answered a 302 and differed (parked as ST-3wfekziw), and held the failure memory in memory only while ST-y45iz7uh kept it under _cache/ (ST-ikj63sqj).
notes: Recurred in SP-htl7jkrm (2026-10-13): ST-ksgrpumr's answer concluded [DER] that a worktree under .claude/worktrees needs no protected-path allowance, while BG-6ecranz3 in the same sprint records the observed denial there; the review found it. Merged from ST-7snky6yx “A research worker checks the repo's own records before it records a fact as not observed, and stops at its brief's turn budget” at the 2026-10-13 draft triage: Same family as ST-k6hwqrd2 (research worker verifies against records before writing a fact; the cited BG-wl36adcq is done). Its turn-budget half is covered by dispatch's turn caps. Touches name the kb-worker.md symlink; the real file is agents/worker.md. Its goal: A goal research worker (kb-worker, research story) searches the repository's own measured records (kb/_self/reports/benchmarks.csv, the reports, the query log digests) for an observation before writing a fact or gap entry that says it was not observed, and reports when it passes the turn budget its goal names. SP-55ddkrrx: ST-a5f7dxbx ran 125 turns against its goal's 60-turn hint and wrote an UNK fact (ci-and-headless.md:99) that benchmarks.csv's router-pinned rows contradict (BG-wl36adcq).
